craft_claim: Tamil Sangam poetics encodes meaning in metre and in situation (akam/puram), integrating sound and sense rather than treating sound as surface.

supporting_evidence.location: The Interior Landscape (Indiana University Press), introduction and translations (cross-link)
supporting_evidence.note: Ramanujan presents classical Tamil Sangam poetry organized by metre and by the akam (interior/love) and puram (exterior/public) situations, where form and situation jointly constitute meaning.

counterevidence.note: Ramanujan's English renderings privilege image and situation over Tamil sound; the prosodic dimension is largely lost, so the sound-claim is limited in translation.

scope: Tamil classical poetry and comparative prosody.
exceptions: Claims about Tamil sound-rhythm cannot be transferred to English-language composition.
